set.body:
Owner: ScalaFIM fit, with reusable factor/solve/buffer capabilities in Gale. Bounded follow-up to native qualification bd-01M1ZAMKEPXXHF8342H0K70NSH. PLS Neuro home epic bd-01M1ZAMMWZCNK5C9CXCVZ1WYTS is provenance, not a cross-store dependency.

Evidence: exact Gale83 resident measurements at 8192 voxels/block512 show approximately451MiB allocated per condition pooling operation and1494MiB for64-output FIR pooling. Source inspection of FixedEffectsEstimates.execute shows per-voxel precision summation, Cholesky and small matrix construction; PreparedPrecisionRun also makes run response blocks and QR coordinates. The current aggregate timing does not isolate their individual cost. The new file-backed receipt separates reads, sink and remaining fit work; use its actual values rather than inferring kernel shares.

Scope: profile the ordinary public selected path and evaluate exact improvements to temporary allocation, response conversion and repeated small precision solves. Consider reusable buffers/batched provider solves and, where numerically justified, a two-run SPD precision-pencil preparation. General algebra belongs in Gale; no private decomposition family or app-specific branch in ScalaFIM. Keep the existing stable QR residual-coordinate variance calculation and full joint coefficient precision geometry; no contrast-first scalar pooling, subtractive SSR shortcut, reduced precision or changed noise model.

Acceptance: independent rational/SVD and correlated mixed-TR reference evidence; unchanged pooled coefficients, selected contrasts/FIR, uncertainty, exclusions, strict rank and source/run identities; optional products off must remain off. JVM and Scala.js gates plus affected direct consumers for any provider change. Reproduce exact qualified resident and file-backed comparisons, retain total allocations and process-memory measurements, and explicitly report fallback/admission criteria. A measured defer/decline is acceptable if a proposed route has no useful benefit or weakens stability. This follow-up does not block admission of the already qualified exact CPU route.
set.title: Reduce allocation in selected precision pooling without changing the estimator
